camera_extension.has_look_at_behavior: PositionCorrection += RawOrientation * float3(offsetX,offsetY,0); rebuild RawOrientation toward ReferenceLookAt and reapply the negated prior camera rotation-to-target offset.
camera_extension.centered_overview_specialization: The recovered CharInfo Overview Composer is centered with zero damping, so the prior angular look offset is zero. The lab adds the camera-local world-space correction to the authored position and looks at the original ReferenceLookAt.

input_driver.target_mapping: target=(verticalCurve(mouseY)*0.15,horizontalCurve(mouseX)*-0.25,0); DOTween setter writes offsetX=target.y and offsetY=target.x

Endminf.boundary: exact authored entry endpoint; capture-time input and the two-second OutQuad trajectory are not recorded

lab_modes.neutral-centered-input: Evaluate the original mouse curves at normalized input (0,0) and apply the settled two-second endpoint.
lab_modes.serialized-entry: Apply the exact actor prefab offsets before UIGyroscopeEffect replaces them.
lab_modes.recorded-input-endpoint: Read normalized source-domain mouse X/Y and apply the original curve endpoint; this does not synthesize the two-second transition.

boundaries: The cursor/controller state in the supplied reference captures was not recorded, so no one live offset is recoverable from static game data.
The lab implements the exact centered-Composer HasLookAt specialization used by CharInfo Overview, not the unrelated no-LookAt Euler branch.
The 2-second input transition and continuous recorded input replay remain deferred with animation; validation modes select source-defined endpoints.
